name: start at the nearest of a few random samples, then walk across neighbours toward the target
mechanism: draw a handful of random cells, take the one whose reference point is closest to the query, and then step from cell to adjacent cell in the direction of the query until the query falls inside the current cell; no index is built

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Jump-and-Walk algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: an algorithm for point location in triangulations

fails_when: non-convex regions can trap the walk
